summary: Addressed the severity gap with a measurement instead of an estimate. The harness now submits 64 distinct read requests, each with its own freshly allocated 4 KiB RequestCtx, to a leader with CheckQuorum false that cannot obtain quorum acknowledgements, sums the payload retained in pendingReadIndexMessages, and counts distinct backing buffers so a shared slice cannot inflate the total. A local run records pending=64, retained_ctx_bytes=262144 and distinct_ctx_buffers=64, confirming each queued request pins its own caller payload - the retention is the retry count multiplied by the caller-chosen context size. Submitted as a successor experiment for the same investigation with three comparisons (pending==64, retained_ctx_bytes==262144, distinct_ctx_buffers==64) and scope notes excluding total-process-footprint and caller-size claims; the interpretation will be revised once the controller produces the receipt.
